description: Get the value at one place in a JSON file, printed as one line of JSON. If it is bigger than max_bytes you get a line "[too big] TYPE, SIZE ..." instead: look inside with json_ls, get a deeper path, or give full: true. Example: {"path": "cfg.json#/states/think"}. $ref/$env objects are returned as written. Details: knowledge_read aos/tools/json_get.json.

path.description: FILE#/POINTER in one string, e.g. cfg.json#/states/think/next; FILE alone = the whole document; FILE#/ is the key named "" (RFC 6901). Relative files start at your workspace.

max_bytes.description: print the value only if its one-line JSON is at most this many bytes (default: env AOS_JSON_MAX_BYTES, else 8000)

full.description: true = print the whole value however big
